mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_digest_default_config ORDER BY source_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_digest_default_config (source_code, digest_mode, schedule_times, overflow_strategy, schedule_days, hourly_interval, night_mode_enabled, night_start, night_end, minutely_interval, overflow_cutoff_time, digest_title_tpl, digest_content_tpl, enabled) VALUES (#{sourceCode}, #{digestMode}, #{scheduleTimes}, #{overflowStrategy}, #{scheduleDays}, #{hourlyInterval}, #{nightModeEnabled}, #{nightStart}, #{nightEnd}, COALESCE(#{minutelyInterval}, 5), #{overflowCutoffTime}, #{digestTitleTpl}, #{digestContentTpl}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_digest_default_config SET digest_mode=#{digestMode}, schedule_times=#{scheduleTimes}, overflow_strategy=#{overflowStrategy}, schedule_days=#{scheduleDays}, hourly_interval=#{hourlyInterval}, night_mode_enabled=#{nightModeEnabled}, night_start=#{nightStart}, night_end=#{nightEnd}, minutely_interval=COALESCE(#{minutelyInterval}, 5), overflow_cutoff_time=#{overflowCutoffTime}, digest_title_tpl=#{digestTitleTpl}, digest_content_tpl=#{digestContentTpl}, enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
